verses.text: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest between the cherubims, shine forth.

segments.text: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest
between
the cherubims, shine forth.

verses.text: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come and save us.

segments.text: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come
and
save us.

notes: 80.2 come…: Heb. come for salvation to us

verses.text: Turn us again, O God, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

segments.text: Turn us again, O God, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

verses.text: O LORD God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?

segments.text: O LORD God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?

verses.text: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; and givest them tears to drink in great measure.

segments.text: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; and givest them tears to drink in great measure.

verses.text: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.

segments.text: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.

verses.text: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

segments.text: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

verses.text: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.

segments.text: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.

verses.text: Thou preparedst room before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.

segments.text: Thou preparedst
room
before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.

verses.text: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof were like the goodly cedars.

segments.text: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof
were like
the goodly cedars.

verses.text: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.

segments.text: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.

verses.text: Why hast thou then broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?

segments.text: Why hast thou
then
broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?

verses.text: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.

segments.text: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.

verses.text: Return, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;

segments.text: Return, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;

verses.text: And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, and the branch that thou madest strong for thyself.

segments.text: And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, and the branch
that
thou madest strong for thyself.

verses.text: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.

segments.text: It is
burned with fire,
it is
cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.

verses.text: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.

segments.text: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man
whom
thou madest strong for thyself.

verses.text: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.

segments.text: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.

verses.text: Turn us again, O LORD God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

segments.text: Turn us again, O LORD God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

headings.text: To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim-eduth, A Psalm of Asaph.
